foundation: C15: Lists, pagination and load-more recovery
identity: Premium royal blue with muted indigo, pearl and slate support.
domain_style: Premium royal-blue attributed-order rows, pearl/slate stable surfaces and indigo loaded-scope guidance; continuation expands a live prefix rather than appending cursor pages.

panels.label: Stable records
panels.specimen: Relationship-style list labelled "Sample attributed orders". Two record rows titled "Sample business order" and "Sample retail order"; subtle indigo B2B and Retail context chips. No order IDs, names, amounts or status outcomes. Helper "Stable identity across live updates". Caption "Newest first within loaded orders".

panels.label: Refresh
panels.specimen: Retained sample order rows under a small strip "Updating attributed orders" and spinner. Helper "Keep search and mode". Indigo annotation "Live records may change". Separate small failed-update example "Update unavailable" and OUTLINED action "Retry connection"; caption "Proposed recovery". No misleading frozen-history guarantee.

panels.label: Load more
panels.specimen: Secondary OUTLINED royal-blue "Load more orders". Separate disabled outlined pending control "Loading more orders" with spinner. Caption "Expands the loaded list". A small distinct inset "No matches in loaded orders" with an outlined "Load more orders" control and helper "Only when more may exist". No cursor terminology in the app-facing specimen.

panels.label: Recovery and end
panels.specimen: Separate examples. Expanded-read failure "More orders couldn’t be loaded", helper "Keep available orders and filters", OUTLINED "Retry loading more", caption "Proposed recovery". End "End of attributed orders", helper "Only after a complete current read". No earnings amount, balance, paid status, earning promise or global search claim.

list_contract: Choose the actual list model per domain: snapshot replacement, expanding live prefix, cursor continuation or bounded one-shot fetch. Do not label a proposal as current.
Canonical query identity includes actor/tenant, scope, filters, ordering and bounds. A changed identity invalidates old requests and resets incompatible cursor/end/error state.
Stable record IDs drive widget identity, dedup/upsert, focus and selection; index position never becomes record identity.
Same-query append leaves prior records and scroll anchor visible. Reconcile changed/deleted records only with reliable current evidence; off-page absence is not deletion.
First load, retained-data refresh, next-page pending, next-page error and exhausted footer are separate states; next-page error never replaces a valid loaded list.
Load-more and retry allow one request per applicable scope; stale results are ignored, failure keeps the last successful cursor/limit and never triggers mutation replay.
Loaded-scope filters/search may produce no visible matches while raw continuation remains possible. Keep a scoped continuation path when evidence supports more.
hasMore derives from raw query evidence, not visible filtered row count. A full page/prefix means more may exist unless a lookahead or exhausted response proves otherwise.
Empty visible pages can advance a raw cursor; use progress detection and bounded continuation. Never loop indefinitely or prematurely report end.
End markers name the exact traversed query. Bounded category reads, partial financial scans, failed reads and cache are not complete global history.
Permission/auth/session failures use C14 sign-in/support restrictions; retry is for recoverable reads, not authorization bypass.
Initial/refresh/page loading and completion need concise semantics, static reduced-motion fallback and labelled 48px footer actions. Exact implementation remains future verification.
Keep independent owned order, payout, transaction, history, catalogue and admin-section scopes separate. Unknown values stay unavailable; no made-up totals, IDs, rates or financial outcomes.
All boards use isolated synthetic/sample list specimens and C01 metadata. C15 is PROVISIONAL_DIRECTION / TARGET_IMPLEMENTATION; no runtime or approval claim.
implementation_status: Design assets/docs only. No app/package runtime, pubspec, navigation or backend changed by this task.
limits: Raster proposals; no runtime/accessibility certification or pixel-exact color/geometry claim.
